title: Pan-Seared Slovakian Bass with Seafood Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring Slovakian bass, cooked to perfection with a seafood tagine served alongside.
instructions: 2. Season the Slovakian bass fillets with salt, pepper, and a pinch of seafood tagine spice mix.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Sear the bass fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
5. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
6. While the bass is cooking, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a separate skillet over medium heat.
7. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
8. Add the white wine and cook until reduced by half, stirring occasionally.
9. Stir in the lemon juice and seafood tagine spice mix. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
10. Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
11. Fluff the jasmine rice with a fork and divide it among four plates.
12. Place a cooked bass fillet on top of the rice and spoon the seafood tagine sauce over the fish.
13. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
